lines.edit.alreadyThere: The line of connections.add[{i}] ({line}) is already there
lines.edit.notList: connections.{key} must be a list of lines. {shape}
lines.edit.notObject: connections.{key}[{i}] must be a line (an object)
lines.edit.removeMany: {n} lines match connections.remove[{i}] (add line, from, to, at, description or fields to narrow it down to one): {lines}
lines.edit.removeNeeds: connections.remove[{i}] needs at least one of line, from, to and at of the line to remove
lines.edit.removeNone: No line matches connections.remove[{i}]. Lines now: {lines}
lines.embedObject: {from} is of type object, so it cannot have an embedding line (delete the fields inside it and remove the type first)
lines.fileForm: The form of before, {path}, is not used: a working directory's file is written by its path in the tree, {now}
lines.fileFormBefore: The form of before, {path}, is not used: a working directory's file is written by its path in the tree, {now} ({e})
lines.fileFormShape: (from the working directory's name, like repo/src:'a.rs')
lines.fromWithTarget: from ({from}) is written when target is a card ({target} is a place inside a card, so the lines leaving it are returned)
lines.ghostNoLines: {ghost} is a card ghost and has no lines. Draw lines from the real card ({real})
lines.ghostNoTarget: {ghost} is a card ghost that points at nothing
lines.gone.holds: holds is not used. What a store holds is written as a line: in the card's value, connections with {"line": "holds", "to": "<record shape path>"}
lines.gone.links: links is not used. A connection is written as a line: in the card's value, connections with {"line": "link", "to": "<card path>"}
lines.gone.notes: notes is not used. A flow's rules are written as a line: in the card's value, connections with {"line": "rules", "to": "<note, freedoc or formatdoc path>", "at": "<item of the formatdoc (the document if omitted)>"}
lines.gone.payloads: payloads is not used. The key of a signature or a hash is written as a line: with the project's line kinds (kind_list), in the card's value, connections with {"line": "signedBy", "to": "<key path>", "fields": {"payload": "<cover name>", "excludes": ["<path not covered>"]}}
lines.gone.pointsAt: pointsAt is not used. What a value points at is written as a line: in the card's value, connections with {"line": "points", "from": "<field path>", "to": "<other card path>", "at": "<landing place inside the other (the card if omitted)>", "fields": {"cardinality": "N:1", "when": {…}}} (a line that points by ID. To point by another word, look at the line kind for that word in kind_list. To choose by a discriminator, leave out to and write discriminatedBy in fields)
lines.gone.ref: ref is not used. Embedding is written as a line: in the card's value, connections with {"line": "embed", "from": "<field path>", "to": "<other card path>"} (the field's type becomes the other card, and removing the line puts it back to string. The field's type when read is ref)
lines.misfit.boardToFile: {said}: from a card of the board, only a "link" line reaches a working directory's file ({written})
lines.misfit.boardToMain: {said}: from the board, only a line that is not tied to a type (one whose base is link, such as link) can reach a card of main ({card})
lines.misfit.dupPeer: There are two {label} (peer) lines from {here} to {there}. Only one is allowed from the same place to the same flow
lines.misfit.embedAt: {said}: an embedding line lands on the card itself (do not write at)
lines.misfit.embedWithFields: {said}: an embedding line cannot leave a field that has fields inside it
lines.misfit.fileAt: {said}: a line to the file ({written}) lands on the file itself (do not write at)
lines.misfit.fileKind: {said}: only the "Implementation" line (implementedBy) can reach a file of the working directory ({written})
lines.misfit.landingElsewhere: {said}: the landing place (at) can only be a place inside {reached} (a field name, e.g. id). {at} is outside the partner. To reach another card that has a value, draw another line (such as a link line)
lines.misfit.landsOn: {said}: the landing place must be {to} ({at} is {place})
lines.misfit.leaves: {said}: this line can leave from {allowed} (not from {place} of {kind})
lines.misfit.noKind: connections[{i}]: there is no line kind "{line}"
lines.misfit.noLanding: {said}: the landing place "{at}" is not in {card}
lines.misfit.sameContainer: {said}: the partner must be a card in the same container ({container}); {card} is somewhere else
lines.misfit.sameContainerNone: {said}: the partner must be a card in the same container, but this card is in none ({card} is somewhere else)
lines.misfit.tooMany: {label} ({name}) allows at most {max} from one place ({n} from {from})
lines.misfit.tooManyAtHead: {label} ({name}) allows at most {max} from one place ({n} from the head)
lines.refType: The type ref cannot be written. Holding the other's shape as it is (embedding) is written as a line: in the card's value, connections with {"line": "embed", "from": "<field path>", "to": "<other card path>"} (with the line, the field's type is the other card, read as type ref; without it, it goes back to string)
lines.shape: connections is written as {"add": [lines to add…], "remove": [lines to remove…]} (a line to remove is the one that matches what is written of line, from, to, at, description and fields; fields compares only the keys written. To write the lines all at once from the start, use card_create's connections)
lines.toBoard.fromBranch: "{path}" is a card of the board. A line cannot go from branch "{name}" to the board (it can go from the board to main)
lines.toBoard.fromMain: "{path}" is a card of the board. A line cannot go from main to the board (it can go from the board to main)
